Scaffold a new HappyView project

Usage: hpy happyview create [OPTIONS] --name <DIR>

Options:
      --json                         Print the result as JSON on stdout
      --name <DIR>                   Directory to create, relative to the current one
      --no-input                     Never prompt; fail when a value is missing. Irreversible
                                     actions still need --yes. Implied without a terminal
      --superadmin <DID>             The superadmin's DID (default: the account `hpy registry login`
                                     holds)
  -C <DIR>                           Run as if started in DIR
      --interpreter <LANGUAGE>       Interpreter language id; repeatable (default: lua)
      --library <LIBRARY>            Library namespace or project name; repeatable
      --project <AT-URI>             The registry project to use for the interpreter or library it
                                     answers to, when several do; repeatable
      --app-name <APP_NAME>          The app's display name (default: the directory name)
      --happyview-version <VERSION>  HappyView version to pin (default: the newest with a binary for
                                     this machine)
  -h, --help                         Print help
